text: Welcome!\nJust because we're friends doesn't mean I'm giving\nyou a discount! Business is business!
Thanks as always! Just buy everything you need\nfrom me from now on, okay? If you buy from someone\nelse, I'll be mad!
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
After thinking about it, I guess using this ark\nfor peddling could actually be a good idea, don't\nyou think?
We can transport what they need over there from\nhere and source what's rare here from there.\nWe just need to cajole...I mean convince Kunon.
Unda is being chained up in the "Raden Tower".\nI wonder what kind of place it is.
Raden refers to beautiful ornaments inlaid with\nseashells~. I'm curious. I wonder what kind of\ntreasure is hidden there.
I mean, who would've thought Unda was a royal~?\nWe all know he's got terrible taste, but don't you\nthink some nobles around him love glitzy stuff?
Once this fight is over, I'll show you how good\nI am at selling stuff!
Hey there! You know I take my work seriously,\nright? Come on, whatever you need, just say it.\nI've got you!
Oh, thanks!\nI promise I'll do a great job too next time,\nso hit me up again when you need something!
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Hahaha, that was a good workout! It's been a while\nsince I last used a hammer like this!
Anyway, after beating that Bakuzan guy, I couldn't\nhelp but act all high and mighty. I gave his\nlackeys some tips on how to use the cannon.
I didn't mean to act cool. Looking back on it now,\nit's kinda embarrassing, maybe even cringey...\nI really shouldn't do stuff I'm not used to.
That battle with the Coenubia boss at Grazen\nTower, though...
Something about it felt off. It felt more like we\nhad defeated a comrade than an enemy...\nNah, never mind. Forget what I just said!
Actually, Kipina is pretty frank and honest\ndespite how she acts. I hope we can all get along.
Well, her unrefined and rather rude way of\nspeaking is a bit concerning, though. I just hope\nshe doesn't clash with Freedos.
Welcome!\nSince you're a special customer, I'll do my best\nto get you everything you need.
Thank you.\nIt's a store I set up in a rush, but I've got\nplenty of goods ready for you. Please come again!

It feels nice standing on the deck of the ark,\nwith the wind carrying the scent of grass and\nflowers.
Still, the breeze is chilly, so make sure to stay\nwarm.
Are you worried about Anono?\nWell, of course you are. He's your friend,\nafter all...
But I think he's been looking better since\nCoenubia's gestalt left! Don't worry! I will also\ndo my best to take care of him!
パッカスタの青域はとても寒い場所だった\nそうですね。\nなんでも絶対零度とか……想像もできません
あら？　いま、くしゃみをされました？\n絶対零度で羽根を伸ばしていませんか？\n十分に暖かくしてくださいね！
Just to be clear, you know this ark was designed\nby Stormia, the Goddess of Wind, don't you?
Exactly, I'm not an expert.\nSo please don't expect too much or ask me too many\nquestions.
Yeah, I've heard the story about this Radi guy...
It's his journey, so we can't decide for him,\nbut I wish I could have at least given him a ride\nand taken him to a safe place.
Vatran the Crimson Dragon...\nA dragonkin like that must have been a tough\nopponent.
You think that dragon could blow the ark away?\nGood grief...I'd rather you didn't think of\nterrifying things like that.
It feels so good when the ark flies. It just goes\nwhoosh!!
Oh? Maybe it's voosh? Or boosh?
Boom boom chicka, boom boom chicka ♪\nLixi today ♪ Lixi too tomorrow ♪.\nSpend a moment with cute Lixi every day! ♪
Ehehe, it's a silly version of Gula the Gourmet's\nsong!
Uh, um, actually...\nNever mind. Forget it...
I heard she's converting various energies around\nher to power the ark while she's sleeping.
It's okay to assume that this journey will be safe\nas long as Navie is sleeping. Now I think she\nlooks kinda adorable when she's asleep.
